title: WebUI UX Improvements implementation task graph

nodes.title: Establish the WebUI UX browser baseline
nodes.description:
Reuse existing browser-smoke conventions to cover the viewport, theme, locale, and motion matrix; assert overflow, focus, target sizing, console health, and the four primary journeys. Record current failures as baseline evidence before product edits.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Baseline scenarios run deterministically without production credentials or external network.
- Coverage includes 320x720, 390x844, 768x900, and 1366x900.
- The harness detects horizontal overflow, lost focus, undersized mobile primary targets, console errors, and unhandled rejections.

Verification:
- bun packages/webui/tests/ux-shell-browser-smoke.mjs

nodes.title: Add privacy-preserving UX performance measures
nodes.description:
Implement safe Performance API wrappers and instrument first-composer readiness, prompt-submit feedback, view-open feedback, transcript restore, and palette-search result boundaries without storing user content or transmitting measurements.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Unsupported Performance APIs degrade to no-op.
- Measures contain no prompt, path, credential, session title, or message content.
- Measurements are bounded and produce no network or persistent-storage writes.

Verification:
- bun --cwd packages/webui --bun run vitest run tests/lib/ux-performance.test.ts

metadata.verificationCommand: bun --cwd packages/webui --bun run vitest run tests/lib/ux-performance.test.ts

nodes.title: Refactor WelcomeScreen into a task-first empty state
nodes.description:
Move primary task entry ahead of advanced launchers, connect localized starter prompts through the existing draft insertion path, and preserve Bug Hunter, Performance Run, provider setup, and solo-session contracts.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Three starters cover understanding, debugging, and implementation.
- Starter selection focuses and populates the composer without sending or silently replacing a non-empty draft.
- Existing Bug Hunter and Performance Run regression suites remain green.

Verification:
- Run the focused task-starter, bug-hunter, and performance-ratchet component tests.

nodes.title: Gate the first send instead of page render
nodes.description:
Remove render-time first-run opening and implement a session-scoped pending-submit state machine covering confirm, cancel, reconnect, unmount, and session switch while preserving new-session picker semantics.

Acceptance Criteria:
- An unchosen first send emits no user-message frame before confirmation.
- Confirmation resumes exactly once.
- Cancellation preserves text, attachments, file references, and focus.
- Session switch or unmount discards pending intent without sending.

Verification:
- Run first-run gate, system-prompt dialog, and draft-restore component tests.

nodes.title: Introduce the typed workbench catalog
nodes.description:
Centralize panel and standalone-view navigation metadata without moving lazy render metadata or weakening View and registry exhaustiveness checks. Activity Bar, Tools Launcher, mobile navigation, and palette view entries consume the catalog.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Every standalone navigable view appears exactly once.
- Setup, parked, internal, and drill-down views are explicitly excluded.
- VIEW_REGISTRY_STRICT retains its literal satisfies guard.
- Tools Launcher coverage remains complete.

Verification:
- Run workbench-catalog, Activity Bar, and view-navigation tests.

metadata.verificationCommand: bun --cwd packages/webui --bun run vitest run tests/lib/workbench-catalog.test.ts tests/components/activity-bar-calm.test.tsx tests/components/activity-bar-responsive.test.ts tests/lib/view-navigation.test.ts

nodes.title: Add deterministic palette ranking and bounded recents
nodes.description:
Replace substring-only ordering with pure ranked matching, active-context boosts, bounded item-ID recents, and stable tie-breaking while preserving combobox behavior.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Exact, prefix, and multi-token matches rank deterministically.
- Context and recent-use boosts do not override stronger exact matches.
- Recent IDs are capped at 10 and removed IDs are ignored.
- aria-activedescendant always resolves to the selected option.

Verification:
- Run palette ranking and combobox tests.

nodes.title: Enable safe shortcuts for new profiles
nodes.description:
Enable the approved safe shortcut set for new profiles only, preserve persisted user choices, and verify editing-surface suppression and modal Escape precedence.

Acceptance Criteria:
- New profiles can open the palette with Ctrl+K.
- Persisted keyboardShortcuts false remains false.
- Single-key shortcuts do not fire in input, textarea, Monaco, or contenteditable surfaces.
- Dialog Escape handling precedes run-abort handling.

Verification:
- Run global shortcut and shortcut-section tests.

nodes.title: Replace the mobile rail with a workbench menu
nodes.description:
Hide the desktop Activity Bar below the shared breakpoint and expose all panel and standalone-view destinations through an accessible, catalog-driven mobile menu while preserving panel coupling and draft state.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Desktop Activity Bar is absent below 768px and unchanged above it.
- All required destinations are reachable.
- Menu targets are at least 44px high.
- Focus is trapped and restored correctly.
- 320px and 390px journeys have no horizontal document overflow.

Verification:
- Run mobile menu and viewport unit tests, then the UX browser smoke.

metadata.verificationCommand: bun --cwd packages/webui --bun run vitest run tests/components/mobile-workbench-menu.test.tsx tests/hooks/useViewport.test.ts

nodes.title: Add non-drag Activity Bar customization
nodes.description:
Provide native Move Up, Move Down, and Reset controls with focus retention, boundary disabling, locked-item semantics, immediate preview, persistence, and corrupt-value recovery. Pointer drag may remain as a desktop accelerator.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Keyboard-only and touch-equivalent interactions can reorder every movable entry.
- Invalid directions are disabled.
- Locked entries expose an accessible explanation and cannot move.
- Focus follows the moved item; persistence and Reset are verified.

Verification:
- Run Activity Bar reorder and Calm-mode tests.

nodes.title: Complete visible-copy localization and strengthen the leak gate
nodes.description:
Move remaining visible runtime copy to locale catalogs, use plural rules, and strengthen the existing English-leak gate only enough to cover currently missed literal forms without broad exemptions.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Chat, unread, restore, iteration, health, and readiness copy use catalog keys.
- Seven locale catalogs retain identical shape.
- Product names, protocol values, logs, and file paths are not translated.
- No new English-leak exemption is added.

Verification:
- Run English-leak, catalog-integrity, and chat localization tests.

metadata.verificationCommand: bun --cwd packages/webui --bun run vitest run tests/lib/english-leak-boundaries.test.ts tests/i18n/catalog-integrity.test.ts tests/components/chat-view-localization.test.tsx

nodes.title: Standardize asynchronous status feedback
nodes.description:
Audit duplicate live regions, align status and alert semantics, add completion announcements where busy text merely disappears, and retain reduced-motion equivalence.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Actions expected to exceed 100ms provide timely accepted or busy feedback.
- Success and progress use polite semantics; time-sensitive failures use alerts.
- Streaming text is not announced per token.
- The same event is not announced twice without a documented reason.

Verification:
- Run the full WebUI component test suite and the UX browser smoke.

nodes.title: Establish and enforce UX performance budgets
nodes.description:
Convert the Sprint 0 baseline into tolerant regression budgets for submit feedback, view shell feedback, palette ranking, transcript restore, and long-transcript interaction.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Budgets compare matched fixtures and avoid CI-flaky precision.
- Material regressions fail while incidental variance remains tolerated.
- Browser smokes execute sequentially.

Verification:
- Run UX shell and page-scroll browser smokes sequentially.

nodes.title: Run the final WebUI UX acceptance gate
nodes.description:
Execute the complete verification matrix, review the final diff, check file lengths, and classify any environment limitation as unverified rather than passed.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Every requirement R1-R12 has direct test or browser evidence.
- No Critical or High accessibility or journey blocker remains in scope.
- Typecheck, full WebUI tests, lint, build, source-policy gates, and browser smokes pass.
- Changed hand-maintained files stay at or below 800 lines.

Verification:
- Run the full command set from the specification Verification Plan.
